sources: Flare 2.0 练后 专项补强 + Flare2 2026-11-21（Google 表 1aCseEk4vslsG-QKb-zsZwg30amvoYh5tMxzy6p9n8vA，Flare2：直臂侧桥转换）

purpose.zh: 从直臂平板整体转成直臂侧桥再转回来，练单手支撑时肩膀和身体侧面的稳定，接近 Flare 换手的感觉
purpose.en: Turn from a straight-arm plank into a straight-arm side plank and back. Trains the shoulder and side body for one-hand support, close to the hand switch in a flare.

text.zh: 先把手肘锁直，整个身体一起转
text.en: Lock the elbow, turn the whole body

text.zh: 平板时手在肩下，身体一条线，脚尖撑地。
text.en: In the plank, hands under the shoulders, body in one line, on your toes.

text.zh: 转成侧桥：撑地的肩膀叠在手正上方，上面的手指向天花板，髋保持高。
text.en: Side plank: support shoulder stacked over the hand, top arm to the ceiling, hips high.

text.zh: 不做俯卧撑，转回平板后换另一边。
text.en: No push-up; back to the plank and turn to the other side.

commonErrors.en: Bending the support elbow while turning.
Hips dropping, the body turning in pieces.
Shoulder not over the support hand.

cautions.zh: 手腕或肩膀疼就改成前臂侧桥
cautions.en: If your wrist or shoulder hurts, use the forearm side plank instead.

training.source: flare2 r3 animation tempo (6 s per side: 1.65 s turn, 1.0 s side plank, 1.55 s back, 1.8 s plank); 表：每侧 6 次左右交替（1 次 = 左右各转一次）

flare2.camera: 头前方斜上（看得到撑地手臂锁肘、整体转动和上手指天）
flare2.doseBrief: 表：每侧 6 次、左右交替；草稿 1 组（组数待定）
flare2.note: Animation r3: 12 s loop = turn onto the LEFT hand (support elbow locked, shoulder over the hand ~3 cm, top arm ~15 deg from vertical, 1 s), back to the plank, then onto the RIGHT hand; feet pivot on their spots (staggered side plank).

reminders.zh: 撑地的手肘锁直，身体整个一起转
reminders.en: Support elbow locked, the whole body turns together

reminders.zh: 侧桥时肩膀在手正上方，髋别掉
reminders.en: Shoulder stacked over the hand, hips stay high
